coffee-pub-cartographer.headingH1Introduction-Hint: Give your party temporary canvas drawing tools and an old-school shared map for planning, marking locations, and coordinating during play.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawing.enablePlayerDrawing-Hint: Allow players to draw temporarily on the canvas for planning purposes.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawing.aboveTokens-Label: Draw Above and Sky layers over tokens
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawing.aboveTokens-Hint: Tree canopies and other things on the Above and Sky layers are drawn over the tokens, so a token under a tree is hidden by it. Off keeps every layer under the tokens. Applies to what is drawn from now on.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawing.timedEraseTimeout-Hint: Time before drawings auto-delete when timed erase is enabled. Range: 5-120 seconds.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawing.hotkeyEnabled-Hint: Allows the configured hotkey to activate the Drawing Tool. The Hotkey is set in the core FoundryVTT settings. (Defualt: L)
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawing.hotkeyMode-Hint: Hold means active only while pressed. Toggle means press once to enable/disable.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawing.blockWhenTyping-Hint: Prevents the hotkey from firing when chat or form fields have focus.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.title: Drawing Tools
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.wallSnapHint: Put wall ends on the points Foundry's own wall tool snaps to. Off places them exactly where you draw.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.wallHint: Pick how to draw them, and what kind and material, then press, drag and let go on the map. Sketch turns a freehand stroke into straight walls, and closes a ring if it ends near its start; Line is one wall; Box is a room of four walls; Ellipse is a ring of walls. Each kind is written the way Foundry's own wall tools write it, with a line over it so you can tell them apart. Undo takes back the walls and their line.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.timedEraseHint: Temporary drawings delete themselves after the timeout set in the module settings.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.holdHint: Pick a tool, then press, drag and let go on the map. Right-drag still pans; right-click to stop. You can also press Stop, or close this window. Sketches, lines, boxes and ellipses are temporary; walls are written to the scene.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.undoHint: Take back the last thing drawn
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.naturalHint: Draw each stamp in its own colors. Off tints it with the brush color from the Drawing tab.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.rotateHint: Give each tree, plant and rock a random turn and flip so a row of trees does not look stamped. Furniture and crates are not turned: use Turn.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.jitterHint: Make each tree, plant and rock a little bigger or smaller. Furniture and crates stay their own size.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.snapHint: Put furniture, crates and the like with their edges on the grid lines.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.sizeHint: Size changes trees, plants, rocks and ponds. Furniture, crates and the like are always their own size.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.turnHint: Which way furniture, crates and the like face: they stay as placed and are only turned here.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.eraseLayerHint: Everything is drawn on a layer: ground under ankle under waist under eye level, with Above and Sky over them. Pick one to erase only from it, as the dirt under a field.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.spacingHint: How far apart stamps fall when you drag, as a multiple of a stamp's size.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.keepHint: Write each stamp to the scene as Drawings, so it stays when you change scenes or reload. Off makes a temporary stamp.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.keepDenied: You are not allowed to create drawings in this world.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.stampHint: Click a stamp, then click the map to place it, or drag to scatter several.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.terrainHint: Click a kind of path, then drag along the map to lay it. Width is in grid squares. A path is temporary unless Keep on the scene is on.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.materialHint: What the wall is drawn as; the kind above is what it does. A fence or iron bars suit an invisible wall, which stops movement and lets sight through, and a hedge a terrain wall; picking one from a plain wall chooses that kind for you, and you can change it after.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.wallOpeningHint: A door or a window is two points: press where it starts and let go where it ends. Drawn along a wall, it is fitted onto it, and the wall is cut around it. Undo makes the wall whole again.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.patchHint: Click a patch, then click the map to put one down, or drag to scatter several. A patch fades at its edges, so it hints at ground rather than filling the map.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.fieldHint: Crops go on a lattice, so a drag lays rows. Drag across the field; the plants fill it. A crop is always the same size.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.eraserHint: Press and drag over what you drew to take it away
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.eraseAllHint: Remove every stamp, path and wall stroke drawn on this scene
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.eraseHint: The eraser takes away sketches, stamps, paths and wall strokes you drew, whole, with a wall stroke's walls. It leaves anything Foundry or you made another way alone. What it takes off the scene comes back with Undo.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.sceneVisionHint: Whether tokens see: off, the whole scene can be seen, as when mapping.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.sceneGlobalLightHint: Light the whole scene evenly, whatever the darkness.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.sceneDarknessHint: How dark the scene is, from day to night.
coffee-pub-cartographer.drawingTools.sceneHint: These change the scene for everyone. Only the GM sees them.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.enabled-Hint: Enable the old-school party mapping tool for square-grid scenes.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.detectionSize-Hint: How far the party sees around their token as they walk, as a square window of grid squares (11 means 11x11). Wider windows reveal more of a room per step, at some cost in performance on large scenes.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.allowPlayers-Hint: Allow players to map with a token they own and control.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.disabledHint: A GM can enable it in Cartographer settings.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.noGmHint: A GM must be connected to validate and save the party map.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.unsupportedGridHint: The first mapping release supports square-grid scenes.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.selectTokenHint: Control exactly one token before starting map recording.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.notOwnerTitle: You do not own that token
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.modeViewHint: View the map without tracking a token
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.modeFollowHint: Track the selected token without recording
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.modeRecordHint: Track the selected token and map where it goes
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.unexploredHint: This map does not cover where the token has moved. Start recording to map it?
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.createForSceneHint: Start mapping {scene} with the selected token.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.emptyMap: Press Record and move your token to begin the party map.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.resetConfirm: Clear everything this party has explored, surfaced and marked on this map? This cannot be undone.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.justMineHint: Only your own maps, by scene
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.noMapsMine: No maps of your own yet.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.noMapsMineToken: Select a token to see its maps.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.noMaps: The party has not recorded any maps yet.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.markRockArea: This whole area is not floor
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.blankCanvasHint: Right-click any square and choose Fix Things → This is a floor to start drawing.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.emptyPartyMap: Nothing here yet. Donate a map you have already recorded, or press Record to map with your token and give the party everything you walk.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.createPartyHint: One shared map of this scene for {party}, built from what everyone donates.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.createOfficialHint: A map as an artifact: draw it yourself, no token needed.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.officialEmptyHint: The scene's walls do not seal any area, so there is no inside to draw. Right-click squares to map it by hand.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.notPartyMember: Only the party can start the party map.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.noPartyMapYet: There is no party map of this scene yet.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.revealOfficial: Hidden from the players — click to reveal
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.hideOfficial: Revealed to the players — click to hide
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.unshareMap: Shared with the party — click to keep private
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.menubarTooltip: Party map — click to open, right-click to record
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.menubarButton-Hint: Adds a party map button to the menubar. It also lets recording continue after the map window is closed, since the button can still stop it.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.recordingContinuesHint: Use the menubar map button to stop recording.
coffee-pub-cartographer.mapping.closeStopsHint: Closing the map window will stop recording. Enable the mapping menubar button in settings to keep recording with the window closed.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.bandHint: Band: repeat only along the scroll direction, as one strip (a tree line, a horizon). The number beside it is the strip's offset.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.tileHint: Tile: repeat the image across the whole scene.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.angleOffsetHint: Turn this layer away from the scene's angle, in degrees. 0 follows the scene; 90 runs it across.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.depthHint: How this layer moves as the view pans. 0 stays fixed to the map. Positive looks farther away, like a distant background. Negative looks nearer, like clouds above. Best kept at 0 for anything tokens stand on.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.startHint: Where the image sits at rest, in pixels, so layers can be lined up. Reset Positions returns here.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.bandOffsetHint: Distance of the band from the top of the scene (or the left, when scrolling up or down), in pixels.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.noLayers: No layers yet. Add images back to front: sky first, nearest scenery last. Use transparent images for every layer but the back one.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.targetCollections: Collections: saved looks for the whole scene, layers and tiles together
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.tilesNotConfigured: No animated tiles on this scene. Open settings and select a tile to animate it.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.selectATile: Select a tile on the canvas, then add it here to spin it, scroll it, show and hide it, or put it in sets.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.tileOpacityHint: The tile's own opacity, the same as in its configuration sheet.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.pivotHint: Where the tile turns, as a fraction of its size: 0.5, 0.5 is the middle, 0, 0 the top-left corner.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.clearTileMotion: Stop animating this tile and put it back as it was
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.resetTilesHint: Put every animated tile back at its own rotation, with its image at rest.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.notConfigured: This scene has no parallax yet. Open settings to add layers.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.toggleInSet: Show or hide this in this group only
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.setEmpty: Nothing in this group yet. Use the pen to choose some.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.forward: Forward: right of centre runs this way
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.reverse: Reverse: left of centre runs this way
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.setNoLayers: Add some layers first, then choose which belong to this group.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.groupNoTiles: Add some tiles first, then choose which belong to this group.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.noLayersHint: Hide every layer. They fade out, and nothing about them is changed.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.noTilesHint: Hide every tile. They fade out, and nothing about them is changed.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.noneShowingLayers: No Layers is showing, so nothing here is visible on the scene, including layers you add. Choose All Layers or a group to see them.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.noneShowingTiles: No Tiles is showing, so nothing here is visible on the scene, including tiles you add. Choose All Tiles or a group to see them.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travelShowHint: Show the distance traveled, and the distance still to go, on everyone's screen.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travelReferenceHint: The layer the party is travelling over. The odometer reads its scroll on the scene's grid.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travelPaceHint: How fast the party travels. Sets the ground layer's speed from the grid, and scales the other layers with it so the depth is kept. Type a number for a pace of your own.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travelPaceUnavailable: Needs a grid in feet, yards, miles, metres or kilometres.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travelFollowClockHint: Take time from Coffee Pub Blacksmith's world clock: at x60 a real minute is an hour of road. The scenery speeds up with the clock, up to four times its pace, and a stopped clock (paused, or combat) stops it and the odometer.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travelDestinationHint: How far there is to go in all. Leave empty for no destination.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travelResetHint: Start counting distance from zero again.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.clockOn: Every route and journey on this map goes with the world's date and time
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.clockOff: Routes and journeys run in real time
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.journeyHint: A journey is routes in order, joined end to end. Snap a route's end onto another's while drawing or editing, and they join exactly.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.removeJourneyConfirm: Delete the journey "{name}"? Its routes stay.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.noJourneys: No journeys yet. New journey, then add routes to it in order.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.journeyEmpty: No routes yet. Add one below.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.dropFromJourney: Take out of the journey (the route stays)
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.oneGap: 1 gap between routes, crossed in a straight line
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.gaps: {count} gaps between routes, crossed in straight lines
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.headingAsDrawn: Heading for the end it was drawn to. Click to turn round; the party stays where it is.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.headingReversed: Heading back to the start it was drawn from. Click to turn round; the party stays where it is.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.followClockHint: Where the party is goes with the world's date and time: as the clock runs they travel, and scrubbing time forward or back moves them along the way to where they would be then. Off, they travel in real time.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.noJourneyToPlay: No route or journey on this map yet: draw a route first.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.whichJourney: The route or journey Play and the speed run
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.timeRateHint: How fast travel time runs: 1x is real time, up to an hour of travel a second. The party always goes at its pace.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.partyOffRoute: The party is not on {name}. Drag the party marker onto it to travel it.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.partyNotOnRoute: {party} is not on {name}. Move the party marker onto it to travel it.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.headingFor: Heading for {to}. Click to head back to {from}; the party stays where it is.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.names.fromHint: Where it sets out, e.g. Zhentil Keep
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.names.name: Name
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.partyOffRouteHint: The party is set down off every route.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.drawFromPartyHint: Draw a new route starting where the party marker stands.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.clockRateHint: This map follows the world clock: the party goes at its pace as the clock runs. How fast time runs is set on Coffee Pub Blacksmith's clock.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.endConfirm: Stop the trip on "{name}"? The party stays where it is, and no route is chosen. How far it had come on this route is cleared: chosen again, it starts from the beginning.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.resetConfirm: Take the party back to the start of "{name}"? How far they had come is lost.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.journeyPaceHint: How fast the party travels this. An animated scene following it shows the trip; its scenery keeps its own speed.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.needsPace: Choose a pace for the journey first.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.drivenBy: Also shown by: {scenes}. Its scenery runs while the trip moves.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.barPlay: Play or pause the trip this map shows
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.noActiveJourney: No journey has been played on this map yet. Play one from the Journeys tab.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.arrivedNotice: The party has reached the end of {name}.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.pausedOnLoad: Paused {name} where the party was. Press Play to carry on.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.markerShownHint: Whether players see the party's marker on this map. You always do.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.markerAddHint: Put the party marker back on the map, where the party is, as it looked when it was deleted.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.markerRemoved: Deleted: the trip goes on without it
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.markerConfigureHint: The marker's image or icon, shape, size, label, colours and animations, in Blacksmith's pin window.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.markerNothingToFollow: Draw a route first: the marker stands on the route or journey the bar runs.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.barShow: Show routes on the map (on your screen only)
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.turnedOff: Routes are turned off on your screen. The eye in the Routes section turns them back on.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.needsGM: A GM must be online to save a route.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.showRoute: Hidden from players: show it to everyone
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.hideRoute: Hide from players (you and the GM still see it, faintly)
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.editHint: Drag a waypoint to move it; near another route's end it snaps on. Double-click the line to add one. Click one and press Delete to remove it (or right-click it). Enter or Escape when done.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.drawHint: Click to place each waypoint; near another route's end it snaps on. Double-click or Enter finishes; Backspace takes back the last point; Escape cancels.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.noGrid: This scene has no grid, so a route cannot be measured.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.paceHint: The pace travel times are worked out at.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.travelDayHint: How many hours a day the party plans to travel. Times are split into days of this length. The same for everyone on this map.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.warnMounts: More than 6 h a day is hard on mounts.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.warnForcedMarch: More than 8 h a day is a forced march: the party risks exhaustion.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.removeConfirm: Delete the route "{name}"? An odometer following it keeps its destination.
coffee-pub-cartographer.routes.empty: No routes on this map yet. Draw route, then click along the road. Double-click your route's line later to add a waypoint.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travelRouteHint: Follow a route drawn on a map. Its length becomes the destination, and the distance traveled is how far along it the party is.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travelPartyNone: The party's trip on {map}: no route chosen there yet.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travelRouteMissing: The route has been deleted; the destination stays as it was.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travelRouteUnits: The route's map is in units this scene's cannot convert to.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travellingHint: The trip's pace and time, set on its map in the Routes window. This scene shows the trip: its scenery runs while the party travels, and its odometer shows how far they have come.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travelUnlinkRoute: Stop following the route, keeping its length as the destination
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.measureNoGrid: No grid -- the odometer cannot measure this scene
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travelHudDragHint: Drag to move. Double-click to open its window; right-click to put it back.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.travelClockStopped: World clock stopped -- no time passes, so nothing moves.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.dragToReorder: Drag to reorder. Drop on the Tokens line to move a layer across it.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.removeLayerConfirm: Remove the layer "{name}"? It is taken out of every group too, and this cannot be undone.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.clearTileConfirm: Stop managing "{name}"? Its spin, scroll and group memberships are removed, and the tile goes back to how Foundry draws it.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.copyNoScenes: No other scene has parallax layers to copy.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.exportParallax: Export this scene's layers to a file
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.importInvalid: That file is not a Cartographer parallax export.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.barOpenWindow: Scene motion: parallax, tiles and collections
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.barLooks: The scene's look: collections, layer groups and tile groups
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.toggleGroup: Turn this group on or off. Groups that are on add together.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.collectionsHint: The chips switch groups on and off live -- groups add together. A collection saves a look for both, and choosing one later switches both at once.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.collectionsNoLayers: No parallax layers on this scene.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.collectionsNoTiles: No managed tiles on this scene.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.noCollections: No collections yet. Set the look above, then save it.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.removeCollectionConfirm: Remove the collection "{name}"? Its groups are not deleted.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.resetPositionsHint: Put every layer back at its Start position.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.easeHint: How many seconds a change of speed takes to arrive: starting, stopping, pausing, or moving the master slider. 0 is instant.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.removeSetConfirm: Remove the group "{name}"? Nothing in it is deleted.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.setsHint: A group is a combination of layers, like Summer or Winter. A layer can be in any number of groups. One group shows at a time, or All Layers shows them all.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.tileGroupsHint: A group is a combination of tiles, like Windmills Turning or Gates Open. A tile can be in any number of groups. One group shows at a time, chosen separately from the layer groups, or All Tiles shows them all.
coffee-pub-cartographer.parallax.tokenLineHint: Layers above this line draw over tokens (clouds, smoke). Layers below draw under them. Moving a layer past the line moves it across.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.barMap: Map walls, doors and windows: click on the map and they are drawn
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.barUndo: Remove the walls added by the last Map a Wall
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.title: Walls, Doors and Windows
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.hint: Click a wall on the map. Shift-click more of the same wall if it changes material. Drag a dot to move an end; Ctrl-click a wall to put a point in it.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.nothing: No wall found there. Try a looser match, or click closer to the middle of the wall.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.tooThick: That area is too wide to be a wall. Click a thinner wall, or raise Widest wall.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.capped: That spread across the map, not along a wall. Lower the match and click again.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.matchHint: How alike the colour must be to where you clicked. Higher takes in more; too high and it spills onto the floor or into the wall beside it.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.smoothingHint: How plain the walls are, in grid squares. Higher gives fewer, straighter walls and drops short stubs; lower follows the painted wall more closely.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.widestHint: The widest a wall may be, in grid squares. Anything wider is taken to be a room, not a wall, and is refused.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.noUndo: There are no walls from Map a Wall on this scene to remove.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.noImage: This scene has no still background image and no tile pictures to read walls from. To draw walls without a picture, use the Walls tab of the Drawing Tools window.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.noBackground: This scene has no still background image, so only its tiles can be read. Click a tile.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.nothingHere: There is no picture under that click: only a tile can be read on this scene.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.failed: The walls could not be added. See the console.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.outside: That click is outside the map image. If it is on the map, the image is not lining up with the scene; the console says what was read.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.collapsed: Found some wall there, but nothing long enough to keep. Switch to Freeform, lower Smoothing, or click a longer stretch.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.hintDoor: Map the walls first. Then click a door on the map: it is fitted into the gap between the wall ends either side of it. Drag a dot to move an end.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.hintWindow: Map the walls first. Then click a window on the map: it is fitted into the gap between the wall ends either side of it. Drag a dot to move an end.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.afterWalls: Walls added. When they are all in, switch to Doors, then Windows.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.fittedOne: {kind} fitted to one wall end. Drag the other end onto its wall end.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.fittedNone: {kind} found, but no wall ends were near it. Drag its ends onto the wall ends.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.noWalls: There are no walls on this scene yet. Map the walls first, then add doors and windows.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.tooLong: That is longer than a door or window can be, so it has probably spilled into the wall. Lower the match and click again.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.windowDistanceHint: How close, in grid squares, you must be to see and light through the window. Further away it is a wall.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.joinEndsHint: For the whole scene, not only this tool: a wall end let go near another snaps onto it, and moving a joint moves the walls on each side of it. Hold Shift to place an end freely. Also the Join Walls Where They Meet setting.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.snapHint: Snap to grid places wall ends on the same points as Foundry's own wall tool: the grid's corners, centres and side midpoints, and the steps between them. Freeform places them exactly where you put them. Holding Shift while you place or drag an end is freeform for that end, whichever is chosen.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.joinDistanceHint: How near, in grid squares, an end must be let go to another to join it, and wall ends must be for Clean up walls to join them. Also the Join Distance setting.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.cleanupHint: Joins the ends of every wall on this scene that are within the join distance, and makes walls that run on in a straight line into one wall. Doors and windows are joined to the walls, but stay as they are.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.cleanupNothing: Nothing to do: no wall ends are within the join distance, and no walls run on straight from each other.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.cleanupDone: {joined} wall ends joined, and {merged} walls that ran on straight were made one.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.cleanupSkipped: {skipped} very short walls were left alone.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.cleanupUndone: Put {count} walls back as they were.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.placedOnWall: {kind} placed on the wall. The wall is cut around it when you add it; drag the dots to size it.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.cleanupNear: {count} more pairs of wall ends are within a square of each other, beyond the join distance. Raise Join distance to join them.
coffee-pub-cartographer.walls.joinEnds-Hint: For the GM. A wall end let go near another wall end snaps onto it, and moving a wall end that other walls meet at moves them with it, so a chain of walls moves at its joints as one. Hold Shift to place an end without joining it.
coffee-pub-cartographer.walls.joinDistance-Hint: How near, in grid squares, a wall end must be let go to another wall end to join it. Also how near ends must be for Clean up walls to join them.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.drawUndoHint: Take back the last wall drawn, and stand where it began (Backspace).
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.drawOff: Drawing is off, and the map is Foundry's. Press Start drawing, then click the map.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.drawFirst: Click to place the first point. Click the end of a wall that is already there to carry on from it.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.drawNext: Last point {x}, {y}. Click to add a wall to it, or click the start to close the shape. Enter or Esc ends this chain; Backspace takes back the last wall; Shift places a point freely.
coffee-pub-cartographer.autowall.drawSketching: Drag to draw a line freehand. When you let go it becomes straight walls, joined to wall ends it starts or ends at. Smoothing sets how plain they are.
